g.text: Title: IsoOpAmpShield - isolated V/I/Hi-Z front end for Arduino Giga R1

g.desc: Title: IsoOpAmpShield - isolated V/I/Hi-Z front end for Arduino Giga R1

g.text: +/-200 V CHANNEL (2 x 499k per leg + 10k -> AMC3330, 1 nF C0G input filter)

g.desc: +/-200 V CHANNEL (2 x 499k per leg + 10k -> AMC3330, 1 nF C0G input filter)

g.text: GIGA R1 INTERFACE (A0/A1 = +/-200 V, A3/A2 = HI-Z, A4/A5 = CURRENT, A6 = ISO_FAULT)

g.desc: GIGA R1 INTERFACE (A0/A1 = +/-200 V, A3/A2 = HI-Z, A4/A5 = CURRENT, A6 = ISO_FAULT)

g.text: PWR_FLAGs (nets fed from the Giga header / through LC filters)

g.desc: PWR_FLAGs (nets fed from the Giga header / through LC filters)

g.text: IsoOpAmpShield rev A -- derived from DualAMCBoard (SE output stage removed; outputs go straight to the Giga as differential pairs).

g.desc: IsoOpAmpShield rev A -- derived from DualAMCBoard (SE output stage removed; outputs go straight to the Giga as differential pairs).

g.text: Giga pairs: A0+/A1- and A3+/A2- are STM32H747 hardware differential pairs (ADC1/ADC2 simultaneous); A4/A5 simultaneous pair.

g.desc: Giga pairs: A0+/A1- and A3+/A2- are STM32H747 hardware differential pairs (ADC1/ADC2 simultaneous); A4/A5 simultaneous pair.

g.text: C15 FIXED: 10 nF -> 1 nF C0G per TI AMC3330 datasheet Fig. 7-2 / 7-5 (input filter now ~16 kHz instead of ~1.6 kHz).

g.desc: C15 FIXED: 10 nF -> 1 nF C0G per TI AMC3330 datasheet Fig. 7-2 / 7-5 (input filter now ~16 kHz instead of ~1.6 kHz).

g.text: HI-Z gain: G = 0.1 x (1 + 30k/RG). RG open: +/-10 V FS. RG 30k: +/-5 V. RG 3.32k: +/-1 V. Input Z = 100 Mohm per leg to HGND_Z.

g.desc: HI-Z gain: G = 0.1 x (1 + 30k/RG). RG open: +/-10 V FS. RG 30k: +/-5 V. RG 3.32k: +/-1 V. Input Z = 100 Mohm per leg to HGND_Z.

g.text: JP1 selects AMC VDD: 1-2 (default) = 3V3 so AMC outputs can never exceed the Giga ADC rail; 2-3 = 5V.

g.desc: JP1 selects AMC VDD: 1-2 (default) = 3V3 so AMC outputs can never exceed the Giga ADC rail; 2-3 = 5V.

g.text: PS1 CCG3-12-12DF isolation is 1500 VDC -- the HI-Z channel is limited to that; the other two keep the AMC rating.

g.desc: PS1 CCG3-12-12DF isolation is 1500 VDC -- the HI-Z channel is limited to that; the other two keep the AMC rating.

g.desc: ADC OUTPUT FILTERS (at the Giga header, low side)

g.text: CURRENT CHANNEL (10 mOhm shunt -> AMC3301, +/-25 A linear)

g.desc: CURRENT CHANNEL (10 mOhm shunt -> AMC3301, +/-25 A linear)

g.text: ISOLATED +/-11 V FOR THE HI-Z FRONT END (CCG3 -> 10 uH/22 uF LC -> TPS7A49/TPS7A30)

g.desc: ISOLATED +/-11 V FOR THE HI-Z FRONT END (CCG3 -> 10 uH/22 uF LC -> TPS7A49/TPS7A30)
